name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ai). Accurately reflects the dominant behavior: an AI/pass-turn action that heals. Consistent with sibling functions in btl_aitg.c (fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile, fd2_ai_seek_optimal_position, fd2_ai_advance_to_nearest_team_target). No Ghidra address residue. Although the function is also reached by the player's Wait command, the AI enemy-turn dispatcher owns 5 of 6 call sites and the function lives in the AI-targeting source file, so the 'ai' domain prefix is correct; a rename would ripple through 6 call sites + protos.h for marginal benefit.
purpose: Pass-turn / Rest action shared by AI characters and the player's Wait command: if the character's HP is below max and it is neither poisoned nor paralyzed, heal 20% of max HP (clamped) with a glow animation + recovery SFX; returns 1 if a heal occurred, 0 otherwise.
logic_summary: Index runtime_char[char_idx]. Read wHP_current (0x40) and wHP_max (0x42). Gate: bail with 0 if HP==max, or pStatus_flags_block[4] (offset 0x25 = poison) != 0, or bStatus_sleep_flag (offset 0x26 = paralysis) != 0. If gating passes: set battle_anim_phase=0; pan cursor to char; wait 1 BIOS tick; play recovery SFX (bank idx 4); paint char sprite in highlight mode (mode 2, color 0xfd) into the world-state buffer (state_buf+0x8088) and blit a 0x140x0xc0 rect to mode13h primary (VGA 0xa0504), wait 1 tick; repaint normal sprite (mode 0) and blit again, wait 1 tick; HP_current = min(HP_current + HP_max/5, HP_max); set battle_anim_phase=1; return 1.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (the 80-byte runtime_char array) selecting the character that is passing its turn. Caller passes the acting character index (enemy-turn dispatcher: the AI unit; player path: the player unit picking Wait).
params.reason: Descriptive, type-appropriate (uint32 array index), no address residue; matches how the body uses it (array subscript) and how all callers supply it.

returns.semantics: 1 if a heal occurred (gating passed and HP was restored), 0 if no heal (HP already full, or poisoned, or paralyzed). Both player and AI callers ignore the return value; it exists for the function's own internal short-circuiting / potential reuse.

comment_original_issue: src comment described the second gating status as 'sleep' (matching the Ghidra field name bStatus_sleep_flag). Verified against fd2-knowledge (memory_hack.htm runtime_char layout + spells.md): the runtime_char header in the KB is offset by +8 vs the Ghidra struct (KB team 0x0E = Ghidra 0x06, KB job 0x28 = Ghidra 0x20, KB HP 0x48 = Ghidra 0x40). Under that mapping Ghidra offset 0x26 == KB 0x2E == 麻痹 (paralysis), and Ghidra 0x25 == KB 0x2D == 中毒 (poison). FD2 has NO sleep ailment (zero matches for 睡眠/沉睡 in the KB; its ailments are poison/paralysis/silence). So 'sleep' was a misnomer; corrected to 'paralysis'.

issues.title: runtime_char field bStatus_sleep_flag (offset 0x26) is a misnomer -- it is paralysis (麻痹), not sleep
issues.description: The runtime_char struct field at offset 0x26 is named bStatus_sleep_flag in Ghidra, but FD2 has no sleep ailment. Per fd2-knowledge (memory_hack.htm layout, which has a +8 header offset vs the Ghidra struct: KB 0x2E == Ghidra 0x26), offset 0x2E is 麻痹狀態 = paralysis status (set by 麻痹術 / Paralyze spell). A future Stage-2 struct cleanup should rename this field to e.g. bStatus_paralysis_flag and update all readers. Out of scope for this single-symbol refine (struct field, not the assigned function); recorded for follow-up. This refine corrected the src comment + plate annotation to say 'paralysis' without renaming the field.
issues.evidence: fd2-knowledge: query.py struct -> '0x2E XA: 麻痹狀態' (KB layout); KB-to-Ghidra +8 offset confirmed via team/job/HP fields; query.py grep '睡眠'/'沉睡' -> 'No match'; query.py grep '麻痹' -> 麻痹術 spell '2-4回合使敵人麻痹', 祛麻術 '解麻痹'. Ghidra get_struct_layout runtime_char: offset 38 (0x26) bStatus_sleep_flag, offset 33 (0x21) pStatus_flags_block[5].

notes: src comment (lines 279-284) and decompiled body match exactly: field offsets 0x40/0x42 (HP cur/max), 0x25 (poison gate), 0x26 (paralysis gate) all confirmed against Ghidra runtime_char layout. Caller fd2_player_inline_action_menu_dispatch confirms char_idx is the acting char index and Wait-path calls this only when have_moved==0. 20% heal + Rest-restores-HP mechanic corroborated by fd2-knowledge intro.md ('下=休息回血20%'). reads/writes_globals: writes runtime_char (HP_current) and battle_anim_phase; reads runtime_char, fdother sfx bank ptr, large game-state buffer ptr; the 0xa0504/0x140/0xc0 blit args are VGA mode13h target geometry constants (not globals).
